summary: acer 16 predator neo has recurring bluetooth connectivity issues characterized by random disconnections and a greyed out bluetooth button. The device also experiences slow boot times and displays a driver power state failure bluescreen error.
detected_fault: A recurring issue with Bluetooth connectivity, likely caused by a faulty Bluetooth module or corrupted drivers.
suggested_solution: Update Bluetooth drivers to the latest version and run a system file checker to fix any corrupted files.
